text:
rachel: Heads-up, deploybot flagged a blocked unpin for model:rlm-small:v1.3. We had a canary eval regression on hallucination rate. Need quick triage and release-note wording.

deploybot: [automated] attempted action: unpin model:rlm-small:v1.3 -> result: blocked (safety-eval failed). Metric: hallucination_rate increased 0.9% -> 2.7% on canaries (threshold 1.5%). See eval-id: eval-2026-03-21-09

mo: which cohort? only hosted or also dedicated?

deploybot: affected: hosted canary cohort eu-central-1 (12 hosts), one dedicated small-pool on customer-beta (2 workers).

gabe: that's the beta customer pool we've been careful with. We kept v1.2 pinned there initially. Did we accidentally roll v1.3 into that pool?

rachel: yes, transient routing rule drifted and 2 workers ended up on v1.3. We flagged it in canary earlier but the safety eval just tripped during spike test.

qa-bot: replayed prompt-set `ops-safety-suite/short-answer` against both versions. Diff summary: v1.3 produced 5 higher-confidence hallucinations (examples attached to eval).

gabe: can we backfill a hot-fix to v1.3 to tighten the entity-suppression heuristics? How long to patch?

sasha: probably a 1-2 hour fix if it's in the postprocessing layer. But we can mitigate faster by re-routing the two dedicated workers back to v1.2 and re-pin model in customer-beta.

rachel: agreed. Proposed immediate plan: 1) block unpin (keep v1.3 pinned globally) 2) reroute dedicated customer-beta workers to v1.2 3) ops to remove v1.3 from the eu-central canary cohort for a quick rollback 4) QA to validate patch in staging and re-run evals before any unpin.

mo: +1. Add rollback commands here. Gabe, please run them for the dedicated pool and ops can handle hosted canaries.

gabe: rollback snippets: 
```
# reroute dedicated workers
deploybot route model:rlm-small:v1.2 --scope=customer-beta --force

# remove model from canary cohort
deploybot adjust-cohort eu-central-1 --remove=model:rlm-small:v1.3 --reason="safety-eval"
```

deploybot: action queued: reroute dedicated workers -> IN PROGRESS (2/2)

opsbot: eu-central-1 cohort adjustment scheduled, ETA 8m. Will post smoke results.

docs-bot: note suggestion: add short line to release notes under "Rollout status": "model rlm-small v1.3 rollout temporarily paused due to safety eval on canaries; customer-beta reverted to v1.2. Will resume after targeted fix and re-eval."

rachel: please add that. Also add an internal "Known Issues" blurb linking eval-2026-03-21-09.

qa-bot: smoke post-reroute: dedicated workers now on v1.2, canary removal in progress. Running quick eval set.

opsbot: eu-central-1 cohort update: removal complete. 12 hosts back to v1.2 routing.

deploybot: reroute complete. All customer-beta workers now on v1.2. Pin tightened: model:rlm-small:v1.3 -> PIN ACTIVE (until 3188896088) by rachel.

qa-bot: post-action eval: hallucination_rate back to baseline for both cohorts. QA recommends a targeted postprocessing patch and a tighter unit-test for the prompt-set.

gabe: I'll open a small PR for the suppression tweak and add unit tests. ETA ~90m.

mo: once PR lands, please ask QA to re-run eval-2026-03-21-09 as a full gate. If it passes, we can schedule an unpin window in the afternoon change window (14:00-16:00 UTC).

rachel: agreed. Also assign an owner for rollback-watch: sasha, can you watch dashboards for 60m and escalate if >0.8% hallucination delta or any spike in customer-error-rate?

sasha: watching. I'll also put a short note in #incidents if anything crosses threshold.

docs-bot: release-note patch created (internal): "rlm-small v1.3 rollout paused for safety-eval; customer-beta reverted to v1.2. Next steps: targeted patch + re-eval before unpin."

rachel: thanks everyone. Gabe, ping here when PR is ready and QA re-eval passes. We'll keep the pin and close thread after unpin is re-scheduled.

gabe: PR opened: github.com/redwood/rlm/blob/PR-452-fix-suppress. QA rerun queued.

qa-bot: re-eval complete: PASS (hallucination_rate 0.8% vs threshold 1.5%). Recommend unpin window at 14:10 UTC with 30m rollback-hook.

rachel: approve unpin scheduling. Deploybot, schedule unpin at 14:10 UTC with rollback-hook 30m and staged cohort (canary -> gradual region roll).

deploybot: unpin scheduled: model:rlm-small:v1.3 -> scheduled at 3188929800 (14:10 UTC). rollback-hook: 30m. staging: canary first, 10% every 5m.

mo: adding note to release plan doc with eval id, PR link, and rollback commands.

rachel: ok closing thread; will follow up post-unpin status.

sasha: thanks all.
